title: See the Artemis II Crew’s Handwritten Notes Documenting the Lunar Surface - Nautilus
gist: NASA equipped each Artemis II astronaut with an offline iPhone 17 Pro Max to document the lunar surface and Microsoft Surface Pro tablets to annotate images, choosing Windows devices for easier integration with NASA computers. NASA has now released images of the crew's notes.

insights.claim: The Apollo guidance computer had four kilobytes of RAM while the iPhone 17 Pro Max has 12 gigabytes, an increase of roughly three million-fold.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Quantifies the scale of compute progress that now lets off-the-shelf devices fill mission roles.
insights.quote: The Apollo guidance computer had a measly four kilobytes of RAM, while the iPhone 17 Pro Max has 12 gigabytes—an increase of roughly three million-fold.

insights.claim: Each Artemis II astronaut was given an iPhone 17 Pro Max, without internet connectivity, to document the lunar surface.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Flight use of a flagship consumer phone is a marketing win for Apple and a sign NASA trusts commercial hardware for mission documentation.
insights.quote: Each one was given an iPhone 17 Pro Max (with no internet connectivity) to document the lunar surface.
insights.locator: Of course the Artemis II astronauts

insights.claim: NASA issued Artemis II astronauts Microsoft Surface Pro tablets to annotate images, choosing them over iPads because Windows machines were easier to integrate with NASA computers.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Enterprise-ecosystem compatibility beat device preference, showing the stickiness of incumbent IT stacks in government procurement.
insights.quote: the Windows-powered machines were easier to integrate with NASA computers

insights.claim: NASA has released images of handwritten and annotated notes the Artemis II crew made documenting the lunar surface.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Public outreach material sustaining attention on the Artemis programme.
insights.quote: Now NASA has released images of some of their notes.
